name: Palette
tagline: Pulls a usable four-part colour scheme out of any reference photo
description: Feed it a picture and it reads the colours back out as a working scheme, split into four jobs: a dominant shade, two supporting tones and one accent. The split is drawn as a proportion bar at 55/20/20/5, and every band carries the hex value lifted from the shot, ready to paste into a design file.
author: subforti
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
